description.value:
The plates of your armor harden and become more reflective, enhanced with defensive magic. When you Cast this Spell, choose electricity, fire, piercing, or slashing damage. For the duration, you gain resistance 10 to that damage type and gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.actions.Item.Reflect Damage] reaction.

@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spell-effects.Item.Spell Effect: Reflective Paneling]

Heightened (8th) You can choose two damage types, and the resistance increases to 15. You can only Reflect Damage of one type at a time.

Heightened (10th) As 8th, except the spell protects you against all four damage types, and the resistance increases to 20.

system.requirements: You're wearing armor with the tech trait, used as a locus.
